responsibility: This file provides the AArch64 target integration points for the D front end. It registers the D builtin target-version identifiers that describe AArch64 and hard-float operation, and it supplies AArch64-specific TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO handlers such as the getTargetInfo("floatAbi") response. Unlike the C-family target file, its scope is limited to exposing stable target identity and ABI properties from the AArch64 backend to D language front-end introspection.
